mapper.select: select id, app_name as appName, app_platform as appPlatform, app_version as appVersion, version_remark as versionRemark, del_flag as delFlag, created_by as createdBy, created_time as createdTime, updated_by as updatedBy, updated_time as updatedTime from t_device_app_version where app_platform = #{appPlatform} and del_flag = 'N' limit 1

select id as versionId, app_platform as appPlatform, app_version as appVersion, version_remark as versionRemark, created_time as createdTime, updated_time as updatedTime, download_url as downloadUrl from t_device_app_version where del_flag = 'N' order by updated_time desc

select id as versionId, app_platform as appPlatform, app_version as appVersion, version_remark as versionRemark, created_time as createdTime, updated_time as updatedTime, download_url as downloadUrl from t_device_app_version where del_flag = 'N' and app_platform = #{appPlatform} and app_name = #{appName} limit 1
